before.method: 15 repeated screenshot-free observations of the original preview form on a fresh headless Chrome session. No provider calls.

after.method: 15 repeated screenshot-free observations of the original preview form on a fresh headless Chrome session. No provider calls. AX enrichment and DOM freshness check enabled.

limitations: 15 observations per version on one small original form. Sequential measurements, mostly warm, no randomized crossover. Screenshot, current-state checks before actions, provider, browser startup and main-agent review excluded. Not a general latency or savings result.
